concerns: Instantiating standard Random with custom seed on each HTTP request could lead to performance bottlenecks or poor random distribution under concurrency; using ThreadLocalRandom or a shared SecureRandom would be more robust.
OutreachAccountService default constructor uses system default timezone Clock which might lead to timezone inconsistency issues across environments; Clock.systemUTC() is typically preferred.
Unrelated DB migration table prefixing changes (telegram_accounts to crm_telegram_accounts) and test updates are bundled into an API contract PR, which deviates from clean separation of concerns.
The OpenAPI contract defines target list paths but lacks schemas or error code specs for downstream target-lists resources, risking ambiguity during implementation.
